Package user

Class User

java.lang.Object
user.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
CareerStaff, CompanyRep, Student
public abstract class User extends Object
An abstract base class representing a user in the system. This class stores common information shared by all user types, such as ID, password, and name.

Specific user types (e.g., Student, CompanyRep, CareerStaff) must extend this class.

Version:
1.0
